title: A diagnose press runs a full coordinator cycle, re-solving the plan to publish an analysis that needs no solve
claim: HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator.async_diagnose_interval ends in async_request_refresh(), so every diagnose press (button or service) enters optimizer._multi_start_minimize 2-4 times (a full main solve, plus a price tile when enabled) although the diagnosis is published by _build_data_dict alone; publishing without the cycle enters it 0 times and still publishes insight.last_diagnosis.
mechanism: coordinator.py async_diagnose_interval: _await_process(diagnose_record) -> _store_diagnosis -> await self.async_request_refresh(); the refresh is _async_update_data, which always runs async_run_optimization (main solve, price tile rotation, fuse-advisor gate, sensor-advisor ranking, actuation and the learners' steps). The diagnosis itself is read by _insight_view ('last_diagnosis') inside _build_data_dict.

evidence.unit: _multi_start_minimize entries per diagnose press (two_zone_dhw); 2/2/2/3/4 over the five houses
evidence.machine: box B1 container (4 vCPU, shared by three seats), CPython 3.14, OpenBLAS pinned to 1 thread
evidence.contention_note: counts are contention-immune; the per-press CPU beside them (two_zone_dhw 1.73 s, duty 7.55 s host process CPU) was taken at load1 7.5 and is provisional

perturbation.change: on the coordinator instance, async_request_refresh replaced by a publish-only twin (coord.data = coord._build_data_dict(); coord.async_update_listeners(), what DataUpdateCoordinator.async_set_updated_data does)
perturbation.observed_value: 0 entries per press in all five houses; worker jobs 3-4 -> 1 (diagnose_record only); diagnosis_published stays 1

metric_definition: Entries into optimizer._multi_start_minimize between the call and the return of async_diagnose_interval on a coordinator with 3 warm cycles.
phenomenon_property: A user action whose only output is a published figure (not a change to any solve input) must publish by rebuilding the data dict, never by requesting a coordinator refresh, because every refresh re-runs the full solve cycle.
seam_rule: grep -n 'async_request_refresh()' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py  # each caller whose state change does not reach SolveRecord inputs is a seam; at the baseline: coordinator.py async_diagnose_interval

null_control.value: diagnose_record_msm=0 in every cell: the diagnosis job itself enters the solver 0 times; every entry comes from the refresh
null_control.note: and the perturbed arm keeps diagnosis_returned=1 and diagnosis_published=1

reproduction_steps: Run the command; read <house>.baseline.msm_per_press and <house>.perturbed.msm_per_press for the five houses (two_zone_dhw, single_zone_dhw, single_zone, two_zone_dhw_tiles, two_zone_dhw_duty).
drop_most_favourable is the mean over the four cells left after dropping the max (4, the duty house): (2+2+2+3)/4.
proposed_fix_scope: coordinator.py async_diagnose_interval: replace await self.async_request_refresh() with self.async_set_updated_data(self._build_data_dict()) (or the sensor-advisor-carrying equivalent); a features.py check that a diagnose press enters _multi_start_minimize 0 times and publishes last_diagnosis.
